name: Rifat Erdem Sahin
tagline: Turkish roots, a US exchange year, no degree, a new start in Britain, and one habit: learning in public. Now helping others do the same while AI raises the bar.
belief: AI is raising the skills bar faster than any school can keep up. The people who will do well are the ones who can teach themselves, and I've been doing that my whole life.

chapters.title: A Turkish background
chapters.text: I grew up in Turkey. That's where my roots, my language and my way of seeing the world come from.

chapters.title: Exchange student at an American high school
chapters.text: Then I went to the USA as an exchange student and finished high school in America. I was living in a new language and a new culture, and nobody there knew me. I learned early how to adapt, and how to pick up whatever the next room expected of me.

chapters.title: The degree I didn't finish
chapters.text: I wasn't able to finish university. For a long time that felt like a door closing. Looking back, it was where my real education started: without the certificate, I had to prove what I could do by doing it.

chapters.title: Learning became the job
chapters.text: So I taught myself, and I still do, every day. I build things to learn them, write everything down (my notes vault is past 46,000 notes), and treat my CV as code: something I keep improving and shipping. Self-learning isn't a side habit for me. It's how I built a career.

chapters.title: Starting again as an immigrant
chapters.text: Then I moved to Britain and started again as an immigrant, with a new country, new rules, and nobody who knew my name. It's the same lesson again: what you can learn and show matters more than where you started.

chapters.title: Working in tech, teaching what I learn
chapters.text: Today I work in tech (I work at IBM) on onboarding and reliability, getting customers live safely, on time, with real money depending on it. Alongside that I make videos, run a Skool community and a cohort, and share everything I learn in the open.

chapters.title: AI is raising the bar, so I'm opening the story
chapters.text: AI is moving fast, and the skills employers expect are rising with it. Entry-level roles are shrinking, and the jobs that remain ask for judgment, specs and delivery, not just typing code. I'm telling my story openly because someone without a degree, without the 'right' start, can still get into the cockpit. That's what the Delivery Pilot course is for, and it's free for students.

values.title: Self-learning first
values.text: No one is coming to teach you the next tool. Learn it, build it, show it.

values.title: Open by default
values.text: My notes, code and mistakes are public, so others can skip the expensive parts.

values.title: Honest about AI
values.text: Not hype, not doom. Here's what the data says and what to do about it.

values.title: Lift people up a seat
values.text: Riders become drivers, and drivers become Delivery Pilots. Nobody gets left behind.
